name: SeLoger
positioning: The historic French professional portal — where agencies pay to be seen, and where most French property searches still begin.
description: SeLoger is a French property portal for sale and rental listings, historically restricted to professionals and now part of Aviv Group alongside Logic-Immo and MeilleursAgents. It sells agencies listing packs, visibility options and lead products, with new-build programme sections for developers.
real_estate_use: For a French agency the SeLoger subscription is usually the largest single marketing line, and its renewal is an annual argument: the agency compares the leads it produced against Leboncoin's cheaper volume and its own website. Because the portal is professional-only, the listings carry mandate information, which is why buyers use it differently from the classified sites.
features: Professional sale and rental listings across France
Agency listing packs and visibility boosting options
Lead delivery to agency software and CRMs
Audience and performance reporting per listing

use_cases.job: Buy portal visibility for a mandate portfolio and measure the leads it returns
Market a new-build programme to French buyers on a dedicated section
